title: WITCHRIV
blurb:
A girl named Nona lives in plain sight among humans, hiding her true identity as a mage as she spends her days in peace with her best friend Lovi. But one day, Nona uses magic to fix Lovi's glasses and subsequently catches the attention of the Bureau of Magic Surveillance. A simple good deed becomes the trigger that sets Nona's destiny in motion...


Note: Won 9th place in the Next Manga Award 2026 Web Manga Category.

title: So you weren't into me?!
blurb: Okabe vowed to focus on his studies in high school, but for whatever reason, the girls around him keep sending him mixed signals…

title: One Piece
blurb: As a child, Monkey D. Luffy was inspired to become a pirate by listening to the tales of the buccaneer "Red-Haired" Shanks. But his life changed when Luffy accidentally ate the Gum-Gum Devil Fruit and gained the power to stretch like rubber...at the cost of never being able to swim again! Years later, still vowing to become the king of the pirates, Luffy sets out on his adventure...one guy alone in a rowboat, in search of the legendary "One Piece," said to be the greatest treasure in the world...

title: Stop! I'm Falling for You!
blurb: Is it intentional or innocent?! A messy-minded rom-com that lives up to its name!! Matsura is a calm, composed high school boy who’s always lived his life putting up a front. He’s good at reading people and can easily see through their true nature, but for unknown reasons, he’s constantly approached by Kyuragi—a beautiful girl with pigtails who’s part of the popular group! Whether it’s intentional or not, her playful and cunning actions keep throwing him off, and before he knows it, Matsura is yelling, "Stop! I'm falling for you!"

title: Blue Lock
blurb:
After a disastrous defeat at the 2018 World Cup, Japan's team struggles to regroup. But what's missing? An absolute Ace Striker, who can guide them to the win. The Japan Football Union is hell-bent on creating a striker who hungers for goals and thirsts for victory, and who can be the decisive instrument in turning around a losing match...and to do so, they've gathered 300 of Japan's best and brightest youth players. Who will emerge to lead the team...and will they be able to out-muscle and out-ego everyone who stands in their way?



Note: Winner of the 45th Kodansha Manga Award in the Shounen Category in 2021.

title: Kindergarten Wars
blurb:
Rita is Convict 999, a former legendary assassin who now works at a kindergarten for the children of world leaders. Her job is to protect the schoolchildren from the clutches of would-be assassins sent after them! But even with her overwhelming strength, Rita has a weakness—she’s head-over-heels for good-looking men! 



Note: Third place at the 9th Next Manga Award in the Web Manga Category in 2023.

title: Morino-san Just Won't Leave Me Be
blurb: Morino-san is laid-back about everything, but languid as she is, she just won't leave me be.

title: Nighthawk, Once Again
blurb: Nighthawk was a hitman who left even the most evil of men shaking in their boots at just the mention of their name. But it’s been eight years since the last hunt, and Nighthawk remains in the shadows. Well, not exactly the shadows. Nighthawk is now retired, living on her own in a pigsty apartment, spending every last bit of money on gambling and gacha games. She’s far from the fearsome figure she used to be and is more of a NEET than a stone-cold killer! But with eviction on the horizon and barely any yen left, Nighthawk will have to make her return. Can this current female failure go back to being the deadly killer of legend, or has retirement turned her into someone useless?

title: Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You
blurb:
At age forty-five, office worker Sasaki has had enough of the corporate grind. His only solace is smoking-and the friendly smile of supermarket cashier Yamada. When Sasaki can't find Yamada after a particularly trying day, a striking woman invites him to smoke with her. The despondent man thinks he's made a new smoking buddy in the cool, teasing Tayama, but Sasaki doesn't realize he already knows her!



Note: On June 23, 2022 it was announced that the manga got licensed by Square Enix. It started being published in the magazine Big Gangan on August 25, 2022.
Winner of the Next Manga Award 2022 in the Web Manga Category.

title: Haunted Peak
blurb: High schooler Miko, who thought he'd be inheriting his grandfather's mountain, has lost his crush to his friend and is at the bottom of his school's hierarchy. His one solace was the mountain, but now a mysterious masked man is building a small cabin there....

title: Gachiakuta
blurb: A boy lives in a floating town, where the poor scrape by and the rich live a sumptuous life, simply casting their garbage off the side, into the abyss. When he’s falsely accused of murder, though, his wrongful conviction leads to an unimaginable punishment—exile off the edge, with the rest of the trash. Down on the surface, the cast-off waste of humanity has bred vicious monsters, and to travel the path to vengeance against those who cast him into Hell, a boy will have to become a warrior…

title: Anta to Osananajimitte dake demo Iyananoni!: Zekkou kara Hajimaru S-kyuu Bishoujo to no Gakuen Nariagari Seikatsu
blurb:
Kazuma Suzuki was just your average high schooler—until his childhood friend, Rua Takayashiki, a beautiful, sharp-tongued girl who also happened to be the granddaughter of the school chairman and the nation’s top idol, cut all ties with him using a line straight out of a drama.

Forced into submission for years as her so-called childhood friend, Kazuma decides it’s finally time for his first-ever rebellion. He’s done playing lapdog. This time, he’s taking back his freedom—and aiming for a normal school life.

Escaping a powerful beauty like her is easier said than done...

title: Dandadan
blurb:
Momo Ayase strikes up an unusual friendship with her school’s UFO fanatic, whom she nicknames “Okarun” because he has a name that is not to be said aloud. While Momo believes in spirits, she thinks aliens are nothing but nonsense. Her new friend, meanwhile, thinks the exact opposite. To settle matters, the two set out to prove each other wrong—Momo to a UFO hotspot and Okarun to a haunted tunnel! What unfolds next is a beautiful story of young love…and oddly horny aliens and spirits?

 

Note: Nominated for the 15th Manga Taisho Award in 2022.

title: My Crush’s Crush
blurb: When Sora Akizuki confesses his feelings to Miya Fuwa, he gets rejected outright. As it turns out, she likes Asahi Suzukaze, the president of the mysterious “Clinical Trials Club.” When he joins the club to learn more about Asahi, he discovers that she also has a crush on someone else! Could this chain of crushes get any more complicated…?

title: Me and the Prez, Drinking Under the Stars
blurb: At 24, Reina Izutsu has recently become the new president of Izutsu Printing after taking over for her late father. Young and not quite experienced, Reina wants to do her best but unfortunately comes across as harsh with her employees. Stressed and feeling lost, Reina spends an evening drowning her sorrows in beer at an empty park. She rants and vents out loud to the starry sky that she wants to give up and quit being president, just letting off steam. Except, she fails to realize that her subordinate, 37-year-old section chief Kenichi Ishizumi, heard her drunken ramblings! But rather than use this against her, Kenichi finds himself charmed by the young woman. He vows then and there to support her and help her find her way as company president, no matter what!

title: Shangri-La Frontier
blurb: Second year high school student Rakuro Hizutome is interested in one thing only: finding "shitty games" and beating the crap out of them. His gaming skills are second to none, and no game is too bad for him to enjoy. So when he's introduced to the new VR game Shangri-La Frontier, he does what he does best—min-maxes and skips the prologue to jump straight into the action. But can even an expert gamer like Rakuro discover all the secrets that Shangri-La Frontier hides...?

title: Akira Failing in Love
blurb: Akira returns to the countryside for high school with a plan to win the heart of her childhood crush! They're both fools in love… because she's too dense to figure out he likes her back!

title: Bus for Two
blurb:
Two childhood friends share a bus ride in silence. Can they learn to talk to each other again?

Shunpei lives in a rural town in the middle of nowhere. His class has been together every year since they started school until one classmate, An, leaves to attend a private junior high. But Shunpei still sees An every day on the bus to their remote neighborhood. After years of drifting apart, Shunpei and An finally start talking again.

On the bus, Shunpei spends his time dozing off while An spends her time studying. The disappearance of a local vending machine sparks a conversation, and the pair break their silence for the first time in years! After several awkward attempts at conversation, they fall into a new routine of bus-ride banter. Can their old friendship be renewed? And could this be the start of something more?

title: Salamander
blurb: At first glance, Manda Miyahira looks like the kind of girl no one would fall for. A so-called undateable girl. But that's only true at first glance... There's no hiding her overwhelming presence! The proof? Manda is so insanely popular that she gets an average of 13.7 confessions every morning! What sets her apart, though, is the way she responds. She meets every confession with violence, reducing every pursuer to dust. But Manda herself suffers most from that violence... To stop her tears, her childhood friend Ryuga Todoroki steps up and confesses to Manda! Are you ready for an ultraviolent heroine meets hot-blooded gutsy guy story in this day and age? The curtain rises on a never-before-seen, super-dreadnought-class, high-octane battle romcom!

title: Tune In to the Midnight Heart
blurb: When Arisu Yamabuki was all alone in bed at night, he was able to find solace in the voice of a radio host who went by “Apollo.” However, one day, she simply stopped broadcasting without any explanation. Years then passed, and Arisu is now a second-year high-schooler. He makes it his mission to search for Apollo, as there is something he wants to tell her. He doesn’t know what she looks like, or even what her real name is, but he manages to get some leads on her in his school’s broadcasting club. That’s where he meets four girls who all dream to get a job where they can make full use of their voices! Just who is Apollo, and how will those four’s dreams pan out?

title: Powerless Without You
blurb: In this thrilling yuri fantasy, Nana’s just out of college, trying to make her way on a series of part-time jobs, when she finds herself whisked away from her bedroom into a parallel world of magic! To her shock, she’s told that she is the great Saintess who will bring peace and prosperity to the whole country. Except for one tiny problem—she soon discovers she has absolutely zero magical power—none! To make matters worse, the princess she’s been summoned to serve with can’t cast even a single spell. A Saintess with no magic power, and a princess who can’t use her own—a pair of failures, doomed to become a laughingstock…or a partnership that might deepen into something more?

title: Dealing with Mikadono Sisters Is a Breeze
blurb: Though Ayase Yuu is the son of a renowned and talented actress, he is below average in anything he does. He is entrusted to live under the care of his mother's friend and later discovers that he will also be rooming with the three sisters from his school who possess both beauty and talent. Though Yuu thought that an understanding would be impossible to reach between an ordinary person and those blessed with talent, the three sisters are surprisingly...?!

title: Rent-A-Girlfriend
blurb: In today’s Japan, “rental” services can deliver an afternoon with a “friend,” a “parent,” even a fake girlfriend! After a staggering betrayal by his girlfriend, hapless freshman Kazuya gets just desperate enough to give it a try. But he quickly discovers how complicated it can be to “rent” an emotional connection, and his new “girlfriend,” who’s trying to keep her side hustle secret, will panic when she finds out her real life and Kazuya’s are intertwined in surprising ways! Family, school, and life all start to go wrong, too… It’s sweet but naïve boy meets cute but ruthless girl in this 21st-century manga rom-com!

title: The Exiled Heavy Knight Knows How to Game the System
blurb:
“You useless son of mine! You were supposed to pull master swordsman, but I never thought it would be this tragic!”

The day a child turns fifteen, they undergo the Ritual of Divine Blessing. Already descended from a line of master swordsman, Elymas was supposed to succeed his father. However, he pulls the defective class, the Heavy Knight, and not only loses his status as future head of the household, but he's also exiled. With their unbalanced stats and seemingly useless skills, Heavy Knights are spoked of as a class for cowards and the lazy. However, Elymas knows the truth. The world he lives in is the same as the one of the game he used to play... It is the Heavy Knight that is the most powerful class of them all. Using memories from his past life, Elymas has set out to effectively conquer this entire world.

title: Shiba Inu Rooms
blurb:
As Kori settles into her new home, her efforts to cohabitate with Mu, her ghostly Shiba Inu, consistently go awry. She soon discovers that there’s something more to Mu’s rejection. With this new information, can Kori learn to live with Mu’s shenanigans? And can Mu break through Kori’s cold exterior? A funny and heartwarming odd couple comedy begins right here!



Note: Originally published as a one-shot, serialization began on 2024-06-27 by re-publishing the one-shot as chapter 1 along with a new chapter 2.

title: Yuusha Party kara Oidasareta Fuguushoku "Wanashi" Unique Skill "Yajirushi" de Saikyou ni Naru
blurb:
"That’s why… as of today, you’re out of the party."

Forty years have passed since dungeons began appearing across the world. Keiichiro, a member of an elite S-rank adventurer party, is suddenly expelled by his childhood friend for being "too weak." His job, Trapper, is seen as useless—after all, it lacks any offensive abilities. Stripped of his future as an adventurer, Keiichiro sinks into despair—until he encounters a mysterious girl who grants him a unique skill.

The skill, Arrow, shatters the limitations of a Trapper, transforming him into an unstoppable force. Determined to reclaim his place as an adventurer, Keiichiro embarks on a journey to become the strongest!

title: Ura Dungeon Oku-san
blurb: After the Demon King was slain, a "hidden dungeon" suddenly appeared in a frontier town, said to be overrun by unimaginable monsters and to hold unbelievable treasures!! The newlywed Yui, about to attempt the dungeon, carries a certain secret...!? The level-99 martial artist who saved the world changes jobs to a level-1 housewife, only to be dragged into tackling a brutal dungeon!

title: Lilim Holic
blurb: A society where humans and succubi coexist. The protagonist, Hayato Yui—an otaku—finds himself drawn to Emu Kato: a fellow classmate, a succubus, and a member of their class's highest social caste. "It isn't lust; I've fallen for her as a person," the outwardly reserved Hayato tells himself. Meanwhile, the equally reserved Emu secretly harbors feelings for Hayato and is eager to bridge the distance between them. Their desires intertwine in this "misguided romantic comedy"!

title: Finding the Invisible Star
blurb: Set in 2001, Ataru, a young factory worker, has just one thing to look forward to each week: his Saturday ballroom dance class. One day, he meets a woman around his age there. Though she insists she's just an ordinary office worker, Ataru finds himself increasingly drawn to Asaka...

title: Aztec Turning of Heaven
blurb: A cruel fate befalls the siblings the moment they set foot on foreign soil. But... you really think I'd accept an ending like this...?

title: The Fragrant Flower Blooms With Dignity
blurb: This story takes place in a particular town with two infamous schools in constant dispute: Chidori High, a boys' school predominantly attended by low-class students with damning grades, and its neighbor Kikyo Girls' High, with most of its female students coming from wealthy and prestigious families. One day, high school second-year Rintaro Tsumugi, a fierce-looking but gentle-minded student at Chidori, is helping at his family's patisserie when he encounters a female customer by the name of Kaoruko Waguri. Rintaro enjoys his time with Kaoruko, as she doesn't judge him for his appearance, but this blissful peace is quickly disturbed when Rintaro makes the discovery that Kaoruko is actually a student at Kikyo. This revelation marks the beginning of the two's strenuous tale, as they fight against the limitations placed upon them by their schools and surroundings in an attempt to find their own path!

title: Kagurabachi
blurb:
Young Chihiro spends his days training under his famous swordsmith father. One day he hopes to become a great sword-maker himself. The goofy father and the serious son--they thought these days would last forever. But suddenly, tragedy strikes. A dark day soaked in blood. Chihiro and his blade now live only for revenge.


Note:
- Winner of the Tsugimanga 2024 Award in the Print Manga Category. 
- Winner of the 4th Magademy Commitment Award. 
- Nominee of the 70th Shogakukan Award.

title: The Oracles of Kami
blurb:
A man with the power to "read" the gods, Miyato, and his younger brother, Kujiki. Their unusual journey leads them to a village abound in rumors that a sacred beast, the Arahabaki, has been devouring humans... From author Fibi Dori comes a spellbinding tale of the chronicles of an epic pilgrimage...

Note: Won 14th place in the Next Manga Award 2026 Web Manga Category.

title: Monkey Hunting
blurb: His final camping trip with his father marked the beginning of the hunt... A chilling new take on terror, distinct from the original novel, brought to life by the supernova creative team. The latest work from acclaimed novelist Toshinari Masuda!

title: Berserk
blurb:
His name is Guts, the Black Swordsman, a feared warrior spoken of only in whispers. Bearer of a gigantic sword, an iron hand, and the scars of countless battles and tortures, his flesh is also indelibly marked with The Brand, an unholy symbol that draws the forces of darkness to him and dooms him as their sacrifice. But Guts won't take his fate lying down; he'll cut a crimson swath of carnage through the ranks of the damned—and anyone else foolish enough to oppose him! Accompanied by Puck the Elf, more an annoyance than a companion, Guts relentlessly follows a dark, bloodstained path that leads only to death...or vengeance.



Notes:
- Volumes 1-5 contain the 16 prequel chapters 0A - 0P.
- Chapter 83 was omitted from Volume 13 due to the author’s request.
- Volume 14 includes “Berserk: The Prototype”.
- Due to the author's passing, starting from Chapter 365, the manga is illustrated by Studio Gaga (Miura's assistants) and supervised by Kouji Mori (a close friend of Miura's).

title: Kingdom
blurb: Xin is a war orphan in a poor village in the kingdom of Qin. He has big dreams of becoming a great general, and when his best friend’s life is cut short by political machinations, Xin sets off to find a deposed ruler and help restore his place on the throne, while working his way up through the ranks of the Qin kingdom’s army to do what no one has ever done before—unify China.

title: Kengan Omega
blurb: Two years after the events of Kengan Ashura, a young man named Narushima Koga aims to enter the Kengan matches, while also seeking out Tokita Ohma for a mysterious reason. He begins to work under Yamashita Kazuo when he meets Gaoh Ryuki, the spitting image of Ohma. Now with a massive showdown between the Kengan Association and Purgatory, another underground martial-arts fighting organization, looming in the background, how will Kouga become strong enough to take part in the legendary Kengan fights?

title: Red Blue
blurb: A story about the sullen Aoba Suzuki and the rising star Kenshin Akasawa making their way into the world of MMA fighting.

title: Ichi the Witch
blurb:
Magic is alive and well in the world, inside beings known as Majiks. By completing a Majik’s trial, a Witch can gain its power. However, only women can become Witches or use magical items. All that changes one day when a young man named Ichi turns the world on its head by defeating an infamous Majik and gaining its magical powers!



Notes:
- Winner of the 2025 Next Manga Award in the Print Manga Category.
- Ranked 11th in Da Vinci's 2025 Book of the Year ranking.
- Ranked 4th in the Men's Division of Takarajimasha's Kono Manga ga Sugoi! 2026 guidebook.
- Ranked 10th in the 19th Manga Taisho in 2026.
- Nominated for the 50th Kodansha Manga Award in the Shounen Category in 2026.

title: Medaka Kuroiwa is Impervious to My Charms
blurb: Mona is the cutest girl in school, and she knows it. In fact, she's worked hard to make her high school debut successful. But no matter what she does, she can't seem to catch the eye of stone-cold stoic Medaka Kuroiwa—but she's not about to give up that easy. Medaka, on the other hand, has been raised at a temple and was told to never become close to women. Who will win in this heated battle of wills?

title: Even the Student Council Has Its Holes!
blurb:
Mizunoe Ume just wanted to avoid repeating a grade when he joined the student council. After all, it seemed like an easy fix to his current academic problems. But then, he met his fellow council members. Each of them is eccentric in their own way-one's an airhead, another's scary, one's secretly a pervert, but all in all, they're just really weird! Yet somehow, they're also oddly cute and endearing. Which means Mizunoe is stuck with them and all the chaos they bring to the table.



Note: Winner of the 2023 Next Manga Award in the Print Manga Category.

title: Fairy Tail: 100 Years Quest
blurb: Natsu, Lucy, Happy, Erza, and the whole Fairy Tail Guild are back in action! And they’ve decided to tackle the “100 Years Quest”—a job no one’s dared take on since the founding of the guild more than a century ago. A mysterious town, a baffling spirit, a ghastly new enemy … and a brand new continent to explore. When you’re with real friends, the adventures never stop!

title: The World's Least Interesting Master Swordsman
blurb:
Due to a divine mistake, Sansui Shirokuro meets an untimely death.

To make up for it, he’s sent to another world. He wishes to be fawned over in classic I’m OP fashion, but when he tells that to God, he somehow ends up training under the hermit Suiboku…

Five hundred years later, when he’s become a full-fledged hermit, Sansui stumbles upon an abandoned baby. He names the child Rein and ventures into the world to raise her…

Thus, the hermit with a baby begins his parenting.

title: Blue Period
blurb:
The studious Yatora leaves a dry life of study and good manners behind for a new passion: painting. But untethering yourself from all your past expectations is dangerous as well as thrilling…



Note: Nominated for Manga Taisho Awards in 2019, Kodansha Manga Awards in 2019 and the 24th Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize in 2020. Winner of the 13th Manga Taisho Awards. Winner of the General Manga category of the 44th annual Kodansha Manga Awards.

title: Marriage Toxin
blurb: A hitman and a marriage swindler set out on the world’s most grueling battle for marriage! Gero is a young man from a clan of hitmen, which has been in existence for hundreds of years. As someone who’s never gone to school and lived his life dealing in the dark side of the business, he considers himself to have “no prospects with women” and marriage as “something not for him.” However, one day, in fear that their lineage would dissolve, his clan warns Gero that if he doesn’t marry and produce an heir, they would have no choice but to…force his little sister into doing “that.” Driven to his wits’ end, Gero asks the target of his work, a marriage swindler, to…

title: The Exiled Prince of Auto-Crafting
blurb: Third Prince Theodulf has been banished to a wasteland known as the Land of Death because he didn't receive a gift from the Goddess. It's a barren land where the air is so noxious, nothing can grow there. Surviving there is impossible... or so everyone thought! As it turns out, Theodulf is a reincarnated being and has received a power known as "Auto-Craft" from the Goddess. Using this powerful gift to automatically create everything, the prince proceeds to turn the Land of Death into one brimming with life!!

title: Genikasuri
blurb: After one fateful match, former professional boxer Ryo Harima awakens from a two-year vegetative state to find out his career is over, his father has died, and he's been betrayed by his gym… Broken and fueled by rage, he vows to make it to the top of the boxing world, but this time as a promoter. Prepare yourself for a story about manipulation and money from the dark corner of the boxing world!!!

title: Haimiya Is Scary Cute
blurb:
At my high school, everyone fears Haimiya-senpai. With her sharp piercings, striking grey wolf-cut, and that brutally honest Kansai dialect, she has a reputation for being downright terrifying. Yet, for some mysterious reason...this intimidating upperclassman is kind and gentle only to me! The curtain rises upon this heart-fluttering romantic comedy about a terrifying-yet-sweet senpai!


Note: Won 3rd place in the Next Manga Award 2026 Web Manga Category.

title: Enigmatica
blurb: World War II. Behind the horrific conflict known to all, there existed a secret war known to none. Codemakers and codebreakers. A story that unravels the lives of men who vanished into the shadows of history.

title: My Isekai Life: I Gained a Second Character Class and Became the Strongest Sage in the World!
blurb: Whether at the office or at home, corporate drone Yuji Sano works all the time. So when his home PC flashes a message about him being summoned to another world, Yuji restarts his machine...only to find that he's inadvertently accepted the summons! Now in a fantasy world far removed from paperwork and computers, Yuji has just one thing on his mind: waking up from what he thinks is a dream and getting back to the mountain of work he left behind! But this other world has other plans for Yuji, who quickly discovers his Monster Tamer character class allows him to befriend slimes! And thanks to their number, those slimes help him absorb so much magical knowledge that he gains a second character class in the blink of an eye! How will Yuji wield his power now that he's the greatest sage the realm has ever known?! And what about all that paperwork?!
